description: List records of a standard sObject (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity), up to an optional limit.

sobject.description: The sObject type to list (Account, Contact, Lead, or Opportunity; case-insensitive).

limit.description: Optional maximum number of records to return (default 200).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a query-result object with totalSize, done, and records; on failure (unsupported sObject), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single record of an sObject by its Salesforce record Id.

sobject.description: The sObject type (Account, Contact, Lead, or Opportunity; case-insensitive).

record_id.description: The Salesforce Id of the record to retrieve.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the record object including its attributes; on failure (unsupported sObject or record not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new record of an sObject with the given field values.

sobject.description: The sObject type to create (Account, Contact, Lead, or Opportunity; case-insensitive).

fields.description: Optional mapping of field names to values for the new record (the Id field is ignored).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with id, success, and errors; on failure (unsupported sObject), output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of an existing sObject record by its Salesforce record Id.

sobject.description: The sObject type (Account, Contact, Lead, or Opportunity; case-insensitive).

record_id.description: The Salesforce Id of the record to update.

fields.description: Optional mapping of field names to new values (the Id and attributes fields are ignored).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with updated and id; on failure (unsupported sObject or record not found), output contains an error message.

description: Run a simplified SOQL query (SELECT fields FROM sObject with an optional WHERE field = 'value' clause).

q.description: The SOQL query string, e.g. "SELECT Name, Industry FROM Account WHERE Industry = 'Retail'".

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a query-result object with totalSize, done, and records; on failure (malformed query or unsupported sObject), output contains an error message.
